video_prompt:
Raw, chaotic unstabilized handheld camera vlog footage held rigidly in Nora's extended right arm as she runs for her life in a continuous, non-stop full-speed sprint through a dense prehistoric forest; violent vertical footfall bounce with every frantic stride, chaotic camera shaking, tilting, and heavy motion blur on background tree trunks as they whip past rapidly. The camera NEVER stabilizes and Nora NEVER slows down, NEVER pauses, and NEVER stops running. The viewpoint is a wide-angle 0.5x selfie perspective held at chest level angled slightly upward directly into Nora's weeping, terrified face, framed off-center on the left. Her right arm remains permanently extended rigidly gripping the camera tightly aimed back at her face; she NEVER drops, releases, or lets go of the camera, and the view NEVER switches to third-person spectator. Strictly NO visible phone, NO screen, NO device, NO selfie-stick. The audience looks directly through the wide-angle camera lens glass.
Setting: pitch-black freezing night inside a dense prehistoric European pine and birch forest in a Dordogne valley, 51,000 years ago. Looming dark tree trunks, twisted branches, thick woodland shadows, and forest floor littered with dry fallen leaves, pine needles and twigs under faint cold moonlight. Strictly NO snow slopes, NO deep snow drifts, NO barren glacier, NO white tundra; this is a dense prehistoric temperate woodland forest. Freezing night air causes Nora's rapid hyperventilating breath to plume into thick white vapor splattering directly against the camera lens glass.
OUTFIT & IDENTITY LOCK (CRITICAL 100% IDENTICAL MATCH TO NORA BODY REF): Nora has a curvaceous, statuesque hourglass figure with an exceptionally large, prominent natural bust, tiny narrow waist, and wide curvaceous hips matching the Nora Body reference sheet exactly; honey-blonde hair pulled up into a high bouncy wavy ponytail tied at the crown that swings violently with each running stride, with wispy curtain bangs over her forehead; fair skin flushed red from freezing cold, slick with cold sweat and tears of terror. Nora's clothing MUST be an exact 1:1 carbon-copy duplicate of the Nora Body reference image in every single feature: a smoked golden-tan deer suede tailored tunic with long sleeves and visible sinew stitch lines; the tunic front has a prominent laced closure with thick visible criss-crossing dark leather cords laced in an X-pattern across her chest from collar to belt (matching the Nora Body reference sheet exactly); strictly NO gaping open neckline, strictly NO bare unlaced slit, strictly NO missing laces, the criss-cross lacing MUST be clearly visible across the front of the tunic; a wide flat dark-brown supple leather wrap belt around her tiny waist with strictly NO metal buckle, NO buckle hardware; long sleek form-fitting golden-tan suede sleeves ending cleanly at the wrists with smooth stitched cuffs (strictly NO fur cuffs, NO fur at wrists, NO fur on sleeves, NO fur on neck or shoulders, NO hood); skin-tight golden-tan suede leggings clinging to her slender long legs with visible thigh gap; knee-high hide boots wrapped with leather thongs. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS (MANDATORY): Strictly NO necklace, NO jewelry, NO pendant, NO gold chain; bare collarbones and clean neck matching Body ref 100%.
0-3s: Nora is in an all-out, frantic non-stop sprint through the dark prehistoric forest, boots pounding violently over dead leaves and snapping branches. The camera shakes and bounces chaotically with every pounding step. Nora's face is streaked with tears and cold sweat, eyes wide in sheer terror as she gasps for air, screaming in desperate sobs while still running at top speed: "HELP! SOMEBODY PLEASE--" (she never slows down).
3-6s: Still sprinting at full speed, Nora glances back over her shoulder, tilting the wide-angle camera slightly: two massive cave hyenas with glowing amber eyes gallop aggressively behind her in the background trees, maintaining a steady pursuit distance about 4 to 6 meters back; running relentlessly on all fours across the leaf-covered ground, snarling and panting heavily, staying strictly at a chasing distance behind her, NEVER lunging forward, NEVER leaping to bite.
6-8s: Nora quickly turns her gaze forward again in panic, pumping her legs with furious adrenaline, weaving between thick dark tree trunks as whipping pine branches brush past. Her breath billows in rapid white vapor across the lens. Behind her in the shadowy forest, the glowing amber eyes and running silhouettes of the cave hyenas continue their relentless pursuit at the same steady distance.
8-10s: Nora continues sprinting at maximum desperate speed deeper into the pitch-black prehistoric forest, camera violently vibrating and tilting with each pounding footstep, fleeing endlessly into the dark night as the snarling hyenas follow doggedly in the background distance. She never stops running for even a fraction of a second.
Audio: heavy pounding sprint footsteps crunching rapidly over forest leaves and snapping twigs; Nora's ragged hyperventilating screams and sobs; echoing guttural hyena snarls and heavy panting in the background; whistling winter wind and rustling branches whipping past.

Dynamic high-speed bird's-flight aerial footage swooping rapidly forward across a prehistoric valley and diving directly into a cliffside cave; fast-paced, smooth gliding camera movement with dramatic forward momentum and exhilarating velocity, flying like a bird in swift direct flight.
Setting: a narrow limestone canyon in the Dordogne, southwest France, 51,000 years ago during the Ice Age. Towering pale yellow limestone cliffs, frosty grass, bare birches and dark pines along a winding shallow stream. Early morning pale grey dawn light with low misty fog drifting over the valley floor. High on the right-hand limestone cliff wall sits a massive dark arched prehistoric cave entrance (Pech de l'Azé cave mouth) with faint woodsmoke drifting out. Strictly NO modern elements, NO roads, NO buildings.
Shot: High-speed forward aerial flight tracking from open valley straight into the cavern.
0-3s: The camera swoops forward at high speed over the frosty valley and winding stream, banking smoothly as limestone cliffs rush past in rapid motion blur; accelerating rapidly toward the towering cliff face ahead.
3-6s: The camera surges upward at high velocity toward the right-hand cliff, aiming directly into the dark arched mouth of the cave; flying straight into the wide cavern entrance, crossing the stone threshold where faint woodsmoke and a glowing prehistoric hearth fire are visible inside the cave.
Clean cinematic footage only: strictly NO on-screen interface, NO recording indicator, NO battery icon, NO text, NO watermarks. Real documentary footage, not a 3D animation.
Audio: roaring rush of cold wind whistling past the camera lens, rapid crescendo of rushing air as the camera swoops, transitioning to a deep hollow stone echo with faint crackling embers as the camera dives into the cave.
